Line 178 is an example request for building a RAG system with hybrid search. It is product architecture guidance, not system reconnaissance.

content.user_title: Build Production LLM Apps and Agents
content.value_statement: Teams need reliable LLM systems that handle retrieval, agents, safety, and cost controls. This skill guides architecture, implementation, evaluation, and deployment for production AI applications.
actual_capabilities: Design LLM architectures with model routing, cost controls, observability, and deployment planning.
Plan RAG pipelines with chunking, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid search, and reranking.
Outline agent workflows using tools, memory, permissions, monitoring, and escalation paths.
Add safety controls for prompt injection, PII handling, moderation, and responsible rollout.
Define tests, evaluation metrics, and staged release plans for AI systems.
limitations: Does not validate production access, credentials, data quality, or compliance obligations.
Requires project-specific model, data source, budget, and deployment constraints.
Recommendations may need updates as model APIs and pricing change.
Not a substitute for legal, privacy, or security review.

use_cases.title: Launch a RAG Knowledge Assistant
use_cases.description: Design retrieval, chunking, vector storage, reranking, evaluation, and rollout steps for enterprise documents.

use_cases.title: Orchestrate AI Agents
use_cases.description: Plan agent tools, memory, guardrails, escalation paths, and monitoring for customer-facing workflows.

use_cases.title: Control AI Cost and Reliability
use_cases.description: Select models, caching, fallbacks, rate limits, observability, and test plans before production deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My LLM Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-engineer skill to design an LLM feature for [product]. Ask for missing goals, users, data sources, latency, budget, and safety constraints first.

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-engineer skill to propose a RAG architecture for [documents]. Include chunking, embeddings, vector database, hybrid search, reranking, evaluation, and rollout checks.

prompt_templates.title: Build Agent Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-engineer skill to design a multi-agent workflow for [task]. Include tools, memory, permissions, failure handling, monitoring, and human escalation.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-engineer skill to audit this AI system design: [design]. Identify reliability, safety, privacy, latency, cost, and evaluation gaps with remediations.

output: The response outlines ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, answer generation, citations, and evaluation metrics.
It includes monitoring, cost controls, rate limits, safety checks, and staged rollout guidance.

output_examples.output: The response identifies agent roles, tool permissions, memory boundaries, escalation paths, failure modes, and observability requirements.

output_examples.input: Reduce LLM API cost for a production feature.
output_examples.output: The response recommends model routing, semantic caching, prompt compaction, token budgets, fallback paths, and cost dashboards.

best_practices: Provide use case, users, data sources, safety constraints, latency, and budget before asking for architecture.
Validate recommendations with tests, adversarial cases, monitoring, and staged rollout in your own environment.
Keep sensitive data out of prompts unless approved policies and redaction controls are in place.
anti_patterns: Asking for a full production AI system without data, scale, compliance, or success criteria.
Treating generated architecture as deployable without security, privacy, and reliability review.
Using external models or web-connected agents before defining permissions and data boundaries.

faq.question: Can this skill write production code?
faq.answer: It can guide and draft implementation patterns, but final code needs local testing, review, and deployment validation.

faq.question: Which tools are supported?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it choose specific AI models?
faq.answer: It can compare model options and routing strategies when you provide latency, budget, privacy, and quality requirements.

faq.question: Can it handle RAG design?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers chunking, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid search, reranking, evaluation, and monitoring.

faq.question: Does it include AI safety guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes prompt injection defenses, PII handling, moderation, bias checks, and responsible rollout practices.

faq.question: Does it require external services?
faq.answer: The skill describes integrations with external AI and data services, but usage depends on your approved environment.
